title: Romans Bible Quiz - Chapter 16
description: Ten questions on Romans 16: the commendation of Phoebe, the long list of greetings, the warning about divisions, and the closing blessing.

questions.text: Whom does the writer commend as a servant of the assembly at Cenchreae?
questions.explanation: Romans 16:1 commends Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae.

questions.text: Which fellow workers in Christ Jesus risked their own necks for the writer's life?
questions.explanation: Romans 16:3-4 greet Prisca and Aquila, fellow workers in Christ Jesus, who risked their own necks for his life.

questions.text: Who is greeted as the first fruits of Achaia to Christ?
questions.explanation: Romans 16:5 greets Epaenetus, his beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.

questions.text: Who is greeted as the one who labored much for them?
questions.explanation: Romans 16:6 says, “Greet Mary, who labored much for us.”

questions.text: Which two are called the writer's relatives and fellow prisoners, notable among the apostles?
questions.explanation: Romans 16:7 greets Andronicus and Junia, his relatives and fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles and were in Christ before him.

questions.text: Which two women are greeted together as those who labor in the Lord?
questions.explanation: Romans 16:12 greets Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord, and then Persis, the beloved.

questions.text: Who is greeted as the chosen in the Lord, together with his mother?
questions.explanation: Romans 16:13 says, “Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.”

questions.text: How are they told to greet one another?
questions.explanation: Romans 16:16 says to greet one another with a holy kiss, and that the assemblies of Christ greet them.

answers.text: With a bow of the head

questions.text: Who says that he is the one who wrote the letter?
questions.explanation: Romans 16:22 says, “I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.”

questions.text: Who is named as the treasurer of the city?
questions.explanation: Romans 16:23 says Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets them, as does Quartus, the brother.
